rawFindings.title: Incorrect token navigation in arrow-spacing rule
rawFindings.explanation: The original code searched backward from node.body to find the '=>' token, which is incorrect as the '=>' token is ahead of the arrow function's first token. The new code navigates forward from the first token of the node to find the '=>' punctuator, which is logically consistent and prevents infinite loops or incorrect token identification.
rawFindings.suggestion: Replace backward token search with forward token search starting from the first token of the arrow function node to locate the '=>' token, and track the token before it to correctly identify spacing positions.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect token traversal in arrow-spacing.js, possibly breaking token identification
rawFindings.explanation: The original code attempts to locate the '=>' token preceding node.body by traversing backward tokens, but the new code instead starts from the first token of the node and moves forward until it finds the '=>' token. This change in traversal direction and approach might cause incorrect identification of the arrow token in complex arrow functions, potentially breaking the arrow spacing checks.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert to the original logic of finding the token before node.body by traversing backward until '=>' is found, or thoroughly verify that the new forward traversal properly identifies the '=>' token in all cases.
